task.description:
Step 2b — validate the design artefact for ISS-0125. HARD GATE: BACKEND-DEV cannot start until PASS.

Run per-artefact checks (mandatory):
  python tools/lint_design_artefact.py src/design/iss-0125-fk-cascade.md   # must exit 0
  exit 0, no BLOCKER/MAJOR

Then verify (manually):
1. Every acceptance criterion in every MUST requirement of GitHub issue #391 has a design element.
2. For Type E (this is Type E): no implementation code is present (no .zig function bodies, no full SQL DDL files inline — design references the migration file but does NOT contain the migration file's body). Prose+DDL snippets in design are fine; full migration body inlined is NOT fine.
3. All public function signatures are listed (Type E). For helpers.zig edits: signature `pub fn resetTestData(...)` is shown, including error return type.
4. Error taxonomy exists or is explicitly stated as 'no new error sets' (Type E).
5. Dependencies documented (Type E).
6. Classification per templates/lego-catalog.md is correct — confirm Type E.
7. The design references src/design/iss-0125-fk-cascade.md for itself.
8. Migration DDL snippet in the design is idempotent (uses IF EXISTS / IF NOT EXISTS where appropriate).
9. Migration header contains 'reapply_on_drift: true'.
10. BEGIN/COMMIT wrapping is described for the FK alter (so it integrates with the schema_migrations ledger).

FAIL if any check fails. Complete handoff with PASS or FAIL. On PASS, set next_action to 'Route to BACKEND-DEV (Step 3)'.
acceptance_criteria: All 10 hard-gate checks documented in result.summary pass

result.summary: All 10 hard-gate checks PASS. Lint exits 0 with 0 BLOCKER / 0 MAJOR (13 MINOR — schema-qualified names in DDL, expected). Per-check: (1) Every GitHub #391 AC has a design element (4/4 ACs covered in section 7 AC-1..AC-5 + section 5.3-5.5 + section 10). (2) Type E — no full .zig function bodies; DDL body in section 4.2 is a verbatim 4-statement snippet for BACKEND-DEV (BEGIN, DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS, ADD CONSTRAINT, COMMIT) plus the section 4.1 file header comment. (3) Public signatures listed: `fn resetTestData(conn: *pg.Conn) !void { ... }` in section 5.2 with error return type shown; section 3.2 states 'no new public functions' for test files. (4) Error taxonomy: section 8 explicitly states 'No new error sets are introduced'. (5) Dependencies documented in section 9 (PostgreSQL 15+, zig build migrate, no new packages). (6) Type E classification correct per lego-catalog.md rule 5 (cross-cutting schema + 5-file test-cleanup rework, not a single CRUD template). (7) Self-reference consistent (only the H1 title on line 1). (8) DDL is idempotent: DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS + ADD CONSTRAINT by preserved name. (9) `reapply_on_drift: true` in section 4.1 file header. (10) BEGIN/COMMIT wrapping described in section 4.2 + section 4.6 (rationale: applier wraps outer transaction; nested BEGIN/COMMIT = no-ops-with-warnings).
